mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average signals an expanding economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1% triggers a signal that the economy is entering a low-interest rate environment, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals a weakening labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 3-month moving average, combined with a rise in housing starts, signals a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production and housing starts are both rising (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price index below its 6-month moving average signals decreased inflation expectations, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the consumer price index is below its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers a signal that the economy is entering a high-interest rate environment, leading to decreased borrowing and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 3-month moving average, combined with a decline in the unemployment rate, signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is rising and the unemployment rate is falling (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales above its 6-month moving average signals increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales are above their 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).
